findings.detail: The duplicate-key example is two distinct source schedule rows with the same issuer, instrument, rate, acquisition date, and maturity date but different principal, cost, fair value, and net-asset percentage.

rationale: B02 flags duplicate position keys for this CIK/quarter, but the raw schedule shows the cited Coastal Marina duplicate-key example as two adjacent legitimate positions/lots, not a duplicated extraction row: row 13 has principal/cost/fair value 8,310/7,896/7,946 and row 14 has 3,831/3,680/3,663. The source therefore supports retaining both rows; the duplicate-key check is over-broad when descriptive terms collide across separate source lots.
